source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: awSetFocusTo captures its element in requestAnimationFrame but does not await or return that callback. Its async promise therefore does not mean that focus has completed. The new-list path requests name focus separately from optional blank-row insertion. This is a local helper contract, not a verified native-focus outcome or a general timer replacement rule.
title: Mailing-list animation-frame focus scheduling does not return focus completion
